headline: Gold Declines After Fed Holds Rates with Inflation Data in Focus
summary: Gold prices slipped after the Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged, as market participants turn their attention to upcoming PCE inflation data.
why: Gold is a non-yielding asset sensitive to U.S. monetary policy stance, dollar strength, and treasury yields.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Holding interest rates unchanged dampens investor appetite for non-interest-bearing bullion.

why_moved: The Federal Reserve's decision to hold benchmark interest rates intact weighed on non-yielding precious metals.
